title: The Milky Way panorama
license: CC BY 4.0 (ESO usage policy, https://www.eso.org/public/copyright/); credit must be clear, visible and unaltered; modifications must be indicated
observatory_instrument: Mosaic of ground-based photographs by Serge Brunier (La Palma and the Atacama, 2008-2009)
image_kind: colour photographic mosaic (approximately natural colour), stitched into a 360-degree panorama
processing_notes: ESO describes it as a 360-degree panoramic image covering the entire southern and northern celestial sphere, with the galactic plane running horizontally. The 2:1 layout is used as a plate-carree map in galactic coordinates (galactic centre in the middle); this projection is our reading of the image, not a statement on the source page. The full 800-megapixel original is not distributed by ESO.
original_dimensions: 6000x3000 (largest public download; full original ~800 megapixels, not distributed)
derivative_operations: none to the file. At run time it is uploaded as sRGB with mipmaps, mapped onto the sky sphere (the scene's galactic-plane orientation is our choice), scaled in brightness by a constant gain, tone-mapped with the scene, and overlaid with a sparse procedural layer of bright point stars for sharpness.
intended_use: Background sky behind every stage of the main visualization (replaces the procedural star field; --procedural-sky restores it). The credit 'Milky Way: ESO/S. Brunier (CC BY 4.0)' is drawn on screen at all times while it is shown.
